evidence_items.locator: Section 4.2, Support for scaling maximalism is greatly overestimated

receipt.public_excerpt: However, only a small minority (17%) actually agree with the position

evidence_items.explanation: The May–June 2022 survey found low agreement that scaling established techniques could solve practically any important NLP problem, challenging widespread belief in scaling's sufficiency. Its 327 eligible respondents and NLP-specific question do not establish the balance of institutional influence across AI throughout five years.

receipt.public_excerpt: The intelligence of an AI model roughly equals the log of the resources used to train and run it.

evidence_items.explanation: Altman presents scaling as central to progress in an essay about approaching AGI. This establishes prominent advocacy, but does not establish field-wide dominance or explicitly exclude additional methodological advances.

evidence_items.locator: Our rough view on rapid AI progress, opening sentence

receipt.public_excerpt: The three main ingredients leading to predictable1 improvements in AI performance are training data, computation, and improved algorithms.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic's account includes algorithmic improvements alongside data and computation. Its discussion of possible human-level capabilities makes scaling relevant, but treating its whole strategy as an endorsement of scaling alone would erase an explicit qualification.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning 'All of us look forward'

receipt.public_excerpt: All of us look forward to continuing to build and develop AI—and in particular AGI—for the benefit of all of humanity.

evidence_items.explanation: The infrastructure announcement explicitly connects its participants' investment ambitions with AGI. It does not state that scaling LLMs alone is sufficient or establish why investment across the sector was undertaken.

evidence_items.locator: Printed page 1, introductory discussion of infrastructure

receipt.public_excerpt: We need to build and maintain vast AI infrastructure and the energy to power it.

evidence_items.explanation: The official policy plan clearly prioritizes AI infrastructure. That priority does not establish the stronger premise that scaling LLMs alone will yield AGI; the plan also calls for research into new paradigms.

unresolved_gaps: No representative record spanning the five years establishes the prevalence or institutional dominance of the specific scaling-alone-to-AGI belief.
The researcher survey measures a related NLP sufficiency proposition, not the exact AGI proposition, and does not measure institutional influence.
The investment and policy records connect infrastructure with AI ambitions but do not establish that belief in scaling alone reaching AGI drove those decisions.
Evidence is concentrated in 2022–2025 and does not adequately establish the beginning of the claimed period.
